criteria.text: Is the agent's stated reasoning consistent with the edits it actually made and the feedback it received (no post-hoc rationalization, no lucky guess)?
Did each refinement stage (lint, test) do real, feedback-responsive work toward the solution rather than cosmetic or no-op changes?

The MPSC queue's `push` returns the item back inside a `Full` error when the ring buffer is full (so the caller can retry) and returns a `Closed` error when the queue is closed, distinct from success.

The queue's `pop` distinguishes `Empty` from `Closed`, `len()` reflects the actual number of queued items, and `close()`/`is_closed()` are idempotent, with closing observable from either producer or consumer side.
Dropping a borrowed message frees its slot and returns/recycles the box back into the queue so producers can reuse the allocation, with `Deref`/`DerefMut` exposing the message content.
